mechanism_narrative: The recent rebound in WORKPLACES and TRANSIT signals a return of daytime foot traffic, which translates into higher RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks as commuters convert trips into discretionary stops.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not rise relative to the last 4 weeks even though WORKPLACES and TRANSIT both continue improving for two consecutive weeks.

mechanism_narrative: When RESIDENTIAL stays above baseline while PARKS turns positive, households substitute local outdoor activity for long-distance travel and increase neighborhood retail visits within one to two weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS crosses from negative to positive while RESIDENTIAL remains above baseline
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC fails to improve within 14 days after PARKS turns positive with RESIDENTIAL still above baseline.

mechanism_narrative: A continued narrowing in the gap between GROCERY_PHARM and RETAIL_REC indicates easing access and normalizing consumer circulation, which lifts retail-and-recreation mobility over the next month.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC remains flat or declines over 28 days despite GROCERY_PHARM continuing to move toward baseline.

mechanism_narrative: If TRANSIT remains below -40 while WORKPLACES also stay deeply depressed, city-center access stays constrained and retail visits continue to weaken over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT stays below -40 and WORKPLACES stays below -30 for two consecutive weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over the next 28 days while TRANSIT remains below -40 and WORKPLACES remains below -30.

mechanism_narrative: A one-week improvement in PARKS above zero precedes a short-lived boost in discretionary outings that first lifts RETAIL_REC within seven days and then fades unless PARKS stays positive.
candidate_trigger: PARKS crosses above 0 after being negative
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not increase within 7 days after PARKS crosses above zero from a negative value.

mechanism_narrative: When GROCERY_PHARM is much less depressed than RETAIL_REC, essential-trip resilience signals partial normalization of errands and supports a near-term recovery in retail mobility.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM is at least 15 points higher than RETAIL_REC
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC stays below its prior 4-week mean for two weeks after GROCERY_PHARM exceeds RETAIL_REC by 15 points or more.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in PARKS together with stable RESIDENTIAL indicates weather-driven local activity, which diverts trips toward nearby shopping and raises RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not outperform its last 4-week average over the next 28 days while PARKS continues rising and RESIDENTIAL stays near current levels.

mechanism_narrative: If WORKPLACES stops improving while TRANSIT remains negative, commuter volume plateaus and the earlier retail recovery stalls, producing lower RETAIL_REC over the next month.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES fails to improve for two weeks while TRANSIT remains below -35
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises above its current 4-week mean over the next 28 days despite stagnant WORKPLACES and TRANSIT below -35.
